QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_36

question.text: In SIA fieldwork, the workbook distinguishes between probabilistic and non-probabilistic sampling methods. Which of the following correctly pairs a method with its category?

answer.text: Stratified sampling - probabilistic; Quota sampling - non-probabilistic
All sampling methods in SIA are non-probabilistic

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.124, in the Primary Data/Evidence Building discussion, categorises simple random, systematic, cluster, and stratified as probabilistic methods, and quota, judgemental, and snowball as non-probabilistic methods. Stratified is therefore probabilistic and quota is non-probabilistic, supporting Option C. The Trap: A mis-classifies simple random; B mis-classifies snowball; D overstates that all methods are non-probabilistic. Note: The category list is on p.124, not p.131 - p.131 discusses sampling methodology but does not enumerate the categories.
